note: The hourly task walks CURRICULUM.courses in `order`. Cursor points at course→topic→structure. Each run authors ONE structure's scene (itemsPerRun=1), then advances structureIndex; at end of a topic's structures advance topicIndex; at end of a course's topics move to the next course in `order`; past the last course set done=true. coveredStructures[courseKey] is a list of structure names already authored (skip duplicates).
